Resolves #19112
Related: #15252

The film can now keep a newborn vessel on screen while the dialogue describes it. An optional, default-zero `birthDwellMs` holds the pointer down after confirmed birth; the film uses 10 seconds, then verifies that the vessel survived without acquiring a target, preview, or conversion. Re-entry success requires its actual event plus retirement. Measured post-receipt pauses give the remaining spoken responses time to finish.

Evidence: L3 (unit controls plus real headless continuous film replay) → L3 required (#19112's focused-runtime ACs). Residual: none for this leaf. Parent production work — native display capture, picture/voice synchronization, perceptual listening and the final 90–150s cut — remains Residual-Owner: #15252. The 103s scene-budget sum is metadata, not measured film duration.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| 1 | CI-covered: `GestureDriver.spec.mjs` default path; existing real film morph/tear-out assertions retained. |
| 2 | CI-covered: deferred hold controls prove birth-before-hold and no later move/release until settlement. |
| 3 | CI-covered: destruction during hold releases input exactly once with no late move; vessel-loss and unexpected-preview controls cancel. |
| 4 | `fiveBeatFilm.mjs` retains scene/cue IDs and existing ownership/liveness checks; measured pacing is documented in the [dialogue receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15252#issuecomment-5794096229). |
| 5 | Outside-CI: `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs -g 'under autoGates'` passes one continuous app-worker journey, 26 beats, held-vessel proof, observed re-entry and popup cleanup. |
| 6 | [Parent receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15252#issuecomment-5794096229) binds utterance measurements and hashes; cold open is 1.500s, mid-birth speech is 9.150s. |

## Deltas from ticket

The long hold exposes a pre-existing false-success path: vessel absence alone could certify re-entry. The receipt now requires `dockTearOutEntry`, and a hold-end check rejects vessel loss or unintended preview acquisition.

Change class: capability. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the Engine baseline jobs cover PR-body and substrate checks.

## Test Evidence

- Real replay: `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<Brain checkout> NEO_NL_PORT=8131 npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs -g 'under autoGates' --workers=1 --retries=0`. Headless Chromium; one app-worker session, no page-video stitching.
- Negative control during development: removing the birth wait failed the three positive timing/cancellation arms; the ordinary path and lost-survival control still passed. The wait was restored before positive verification.
- Generated audio passed decode/format/duration checks; automated ASR is a content check, not perceptual or picture-sync acceptance. Audio assets and private provider receipts remain in the existing production record.
